raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: Adopted a flawed methodology by taking the “first listed” date on IMDb Release Dates as the release date, which captured later home-media/re-release entries (2007 for Premium, 2011 for Week-End with Father) instead of the earliest public/theatrical releases. This contradicted earlier credible evidence (Premium 2006; Week-End with Father 1951) and led to the incorrect conclusion that Premium was released earlier.
